# ⚠️ GENERATED DIRECTORY — DO NOT EDIT

The per-festival folders in here (`sziget-2026/`, `novarock-2026/`, …) are copied from `festivals/<festival-id>/` at the repo root by `scripts/sync-data.mjs`. Direct edits here are silently overwritten on the next sync.

**To change festival data:** edit `festivals/<festival-id>/data/*.json` or `festivals/<festival-id>/config.json` at the repo root, then run:

```bash
npm run lineup:sync
```
